special_situations.headline: The Exchange has received Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 on August 21, 2026 for BCP Asia II Topco IV Pte Ltd
special_situations.summary: PE sponsor BCP Asia II pledged 100% of its 29.71% Aster stake for $750mn loan
special_situations.impact: $750mn (~₹7,181 Cr) facility vs Aster's FY26 pro forma revenue of ~₹9,273 Cr and market cap of ~₹66,382 Cr; loan proceeds partly for sponsor dividends/refinancing, not for Aster's own capex
special_situations.risk: Full pledge of sponsor stake risks overhang/margin-call if BCP Asia defaults
special_situations.view_reasoning: Business fundamentals strong (pro forma revenue/EBITDA growing double digits) but 100% promoter pledge for a dividend-recap-style loan is a leverage red flag.

special_situations.headline: Nyssa Corporation Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 27/08/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve its'' Stake Sale in Proprietorship Firm
special_situations.summary: Board to consider sale of stake in a proprietorship firm on 27 Aug 2026
special_situations.impact: No deal value disclosed; company is a micro-cap (~$1.37M market cap, ~$384K TTM revenue) so even a small sale could be relatively significant
special_situations.risk: Micro-cap with sparse disclosures; prior similar stake sale hurt revenue comparability
special_situations.view_reasoning: Only an intent-to-consider notice; firm already sold 99% stake in Mark Developer in Nov 2025, shrinking base.

special_situations.headline: Update on Acquisition
special_situations.summary: Executed SPA to acquire 100% of JSW Overseas FZE, making it a direct subsidiary
special_situations.impact: Not stated (no deal value disclosed); internal group reorg, not a new external asset — JSW Overseas holds the 51% stake in Oman's ~₹3,700 Cr Port SPV project
special_situations.risk: Pending regulatory approvals in India and UAE; related-party intra-group transaction
special_situations.view_reasoning: Structural reorg with no immediate earnings impact; FY26 revenue ₹5,361 Cr, stock already elevated at ~37-39x P/E.

special_situations.headline: Disclosure under Reg. 30 of SEBI / LODR Regulations 2015 regarding Order passed by Hon''ble NCLT dated August 21, 2026 in the matter of RCIL, a subsidiary of RCOM.
special_situations.summary: NCLT passed a fresh order in RCIL matter, part of long-running RCOM group insolvency
special_situations.impact: Not stated — no deal value in headline; RCOM group's IBC case involves ~₹46,000 Cr original lender claims, but specifics of this particular order weren't disclosed
special_situations.risk: Equity likely to get zero/negligible recovery regardless of order outcome
special_situations.view_reasoning: Stock trades near ₹0.80, deep in CIRP for years; lenders have priority and equity holders face near-total wipeout per recent commentary.

special_situations.headline: Scheme of Arrangement Update
special_situations.summary: NCLT sanctioned demerger of distillery division into subsidiary KM Spirits, effective Apr 2026
special_situations.impact: Distillery segment is ~13% of revenue (₹91.2 Cr distillery vs ~₹678 Cr FY26 total revenue)
special_situations.risk: Rating agency flagged uncertainty on post-demerger capital structure/credit profile
special_situations.view_reasoning: Scheme now sanctioned and stock rallied on news, but rating agency has an active Rating Watch on post-split credit profile.

special_situations.headline: Outcome of the Meeting of the Board of Directors held on Monday, 24 August 2026 - In-principle approval for proposed acquisition
special_situations.summary: Board gave in-principle approval to acquire a US healthcare entity plus preferential fundraise
special_situations.impact: Deal value not disclosed (terms pending); for context <cite index="50-7,50-10">Blue Cloud Softech Solutions FY26 recorded revenue from operations of ₹1,002 crore, compared with ₹796.86 crore in FY25, with profit after tax at ₹60.50 crore, up from ₹44.27 crore in FY25</cite>.
special_situations.risk: Consideration/structure undisclosed; preferential issue could dilute existing shareholders
special_situations.view_reasoning: Strong FY26 growth and profitability, but deal size and dilution impact unknown until definitive terms signed

special_situations.summary: Mandatory open offer to acquire 26% stake at ₹15/share, triggering change in control
special_situations.impact: ~₹3.4 Cr open offer (22.88L shares x ₹15) vs a micro-cap with <cite index="53-1">Revenue: 8.16 Cr and Mkt Cap: 13.7 Crore</cite>; small in absolute terms but changes control of the entire company.
special_situations.risk: Target flagged for historical SEBI SAST non-compliance; acquirer/promoter track record unclear
special_situations.view_reasoning: Change of control at a loss-making micro-cap with weak revenue trend and a flagged compliance history adds uncertainty

special_situations.headline: The Exchange has received Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 on August 21, 2026 for Hemal V Mehta & Sachin V Mehta
special_situations.summary: Promoters pledged 13.2 lakh shares (5.28% of capital) as loan security to Satin Finserv
special_situations.impact: Small pledge relative to company scale — <cite index="42-2,42-3">revenue increasing to Rs. 505.05 Crores in FY25</cite>; qualitative leverage signal rather than a transaction with disclosed monetary deal size.
special_situations.risk: Promoter share pledging can signal rising personal/corporate leverage or liquidity needs
special_situations.view_reasoning: Pledge is modest (5.28%) against a company with growing FY25 revenue; not alarming alone but worth monitoring for further encumbrance

special_situations.impact: No deal figure — insolvency proceedings remain paused, operations and FY26 dividend plan continue as normal

special_situations.view_reasoning: Stock near 52-week low, declining profit margins, but stay keeps status quo pending September hearing
